name: criterion-tagged-outside-matrix-row
comment: A tag on another test case must not back an acceptance criterion; the correctly paired test remains a control.

input.module:
name: row-aware-binding
version: 0.1.0
artifact_types:
- name: FR
- name: TestMatrix
traceability:
  trace_targets:
  - name: acceptance-criterion
    archetype: FR
    section: Acceptance Criteria
    id_column: ID
  - name: test-case
    archetype: TestMatrix
    section: Test Cases
    id_column: ID
  document_references:
  - name: verification
    archetype: FR
    section: Acceptance Criteria
    row_id_column: ID
    column: Verification
    pattern: '\b(TC-\d+)\b'
    targets: [test-case]
  - name: traces-to
    archetype: TestMatrix
    section: Test Cases
    row_id_column: ID
    column: Traces To
    pattern: '\b((?:FR|TC)-\d+(?:-AC-\d+)?)\b'
    targets: [acceptance-criterion, test-case]
  status:
    column: Status
    complete: ["✅"]
    pending: ["🚧"]
  obligations:
  - name: acceptance-criteria
    target: acceptance-criterion
    statement_column: Criteria
    method_column: Verification
  trace_tags:
    markers:
    - name: rust-trace-attribute
      language: rust
      pattern: '#\[trace\(([^)]*)\)\]'
      template: '#[trace({ids})]'
